description: AutoChangelog is a SaaS that generates user-facing release notes from GitHub repositories when deployments occur. It publishes changelog pages and embeds, and supports custom domains for those changelogs.
summary: AutoChangelog exposes two documented HTTP developer surfaces on autochangelog.com: a per-repository webhook trigger API authenticated by HMAC signature and a REST API authenticated by bearer API key; it also serves public embeddable changelog widget scripts.
